item.title: Self-Hosted MPTCP Solutions: OpenMPTCProuter vs mptcpd vs Kernel MPTCP
item.description: Multipath TCP (MPTCP) allows a single TCP connection to use multiple network paths simultaneously. This means a device can aggregate a wired Ethernet connection, a Wi-Fi link, and a cellular connection into one high-throughput, resilient connection. If one path fails, the connection survives on the remaining paths.
